chapter: Dreamland and the Tuxedo dance hall
title: The Parker brothers buy a building and open the Tuxedo dance hall
summary: The Parker brothers and New York friends buy a big sporting house on Franklin Street across from the 101 Ranch and turn it into a dance hall with a high balcony bandstand, after the 1915 storm.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
